question: Under POCSO Act 2012, a doctor who examines a suspected child abuse victim must report to the police or Special Juvenile Police Unit regardless of parental consent.

l10n.wrongAnswerMessage: Review POCSO Section 19: reporting is mandatory for all persons, including medical professionals. The law does not permit a doctor to withhold reporting based on parental refusal or confidentiality concerns.
l10n.correctAnswerMessage: Correct. Section 19 POCSO 2012 mandates immediate reporting by any person with knowledge or apprehension of an offence. Failure to report is a cognisable offence under Section 21. Parental consent is not required and cannot override this duty.
